chapter: Highlights, the reunion album and fellow musicians
title: Dud Bascomb singing 'Born Loser'
summary: Dud sang on the Reunion album for the first time.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Right. One thing that I just remembered on that Reunion album. That was the first time I heard Dud Bascomb sing.
Right. He did, that was his tune.
Right. That was his tune, I think. His and Sam's tune, "Born Loser".
I, it's the first time I heard him. Yeah. He was doing all those years playing, he never tried to sing with us.
But he, he did a pretty good job with it. He could have had a nice tune.
Yeah. "Born Loser". I think he and Sam put that together. I told him about it after. I said why didn't you tell
me you could sing? You waited all these years?
